# Data

This directory holds the **training-side** data for NeuroStat. The adversarial
**MOSAIC benchmark** is released together with the repository and lives under
[`../benchmark/`](../benchmark), not here.

## Pair-format JSON (recommended)

Training and evaluation files follow the **`MIRAGE`** pair format:

```json
[
    {
        "original":  "A paragraph written by a human ...",
        "rewritten": "The same paragraph regenerated by an LLM ..."
    },
    {
        "original":  "...",
        "rewritten": "..."
    }
]
```

Within every pair:

- `original`  → human-written text, gets label `Human` (class id `0`).
- `rewritten` → machine-generated text, gets label `AIGC`  (class id `1`).

Any additional per-pair fields (e.g. `category`, `sub_method`, `model`) are
ignored by the data loader and may be kept for analysis.

Alternatively, pass `--train_data_format pair` / `--eval_data_format pair` to
use the twin-list layout:

```json
{
    "original":  ["...", "...", "..."],
    "rewritten": ["...", "...", "..."]
}
```

## Where to place training data

Put any training / in-domain test JSON file here (e.g. `data/train.json`,
`data/test.json`) and point the entry scripts at it:

```bash
python train.py \
    --train_data_path data/train.json \
    --train_data_format MIRAGE \
    --output_dir ./ckpt/neurostat
```

> This folder is intentionally listed in `.gitignore` (except for this
> README) so that any JSON files you drop in are **not** accidentally
> committed. Please provide / download training data yourself.

## MOSAIC benchmark

The 8-category MOSAIC adversarial benchmark is shipped at
[`../benchmark/`](../benchmark) with one JSON per category, each following
the `MIRAGE` pair format above. Evaluate on the whole benchmark with:

```bash
MODEL_PATH=./ckpt/neurostat \
SAVE_PATH=./results/neurostat_mosaic \
bash scripts/eval_mosaic.sh
```

See the top-level [`README.md`](../README.md) for the full category table.
